fields.description:
Carry the configured implementation budget caps from `Settings` into `DraftPullRequestInput` so `IMPLEMENTATION_MAX_LLM_CALLS`, `IMPLEMENTATION_MAX_TOKENS`, and `IMPLEMENTATION_MAX_COST_USD` govern execution.

`DraftPullRequestInput` carries `max_cost_usd`, `max_llm_calls`, and `max_tokens`, and the dataclass supplies defaults of 5.0 US dollars, 200 LLM calls, and 2000000 tokens for any caller that leaves them out. The workflow enforces whatever it is given, since `_budget_breach` compares against `params.max_llm_calls`, `params.max_tokens`, and `params.max_cost_usd` and ends the run with a terminal reason on a breach. A caller that omits the three fields therefore pins every run to the dataclass defaults and makes the three settings inert, so an operator raising a cap for a large target repository sees no change in execution.

Two callers start the workflow. `TemporalStarter.start` in `services/orchestration/intake_runtime.py` serves the Jira intake path used by the poller and the webhook, and `_run_via_temporal` in `scripts/demo_draft_pr.py` serves the operator-driven demo. Both must populate the three fields from `BudgetCaps.from_settings`, the existing helper that reads those settings and that `scripts/cost_rollup.py` and `scripts/reconcile_usage.py` already use, so execution and reporting derive the caps from one place. Where no setting overrides a cap, the value must match the shared `BudgetCaps` default rather than a separately written constant.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Intake carries the configured LLM call cap into the workflow input, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_intake_runtime.py -k intake_carries_the_configured_llm_call_cap`
- [ ] Intake carries the configured token cap into the workflow input, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_intake_runtime.py -k intake_carries_the_configured_token_cap`
- [ ] Intake carries the configured cost cap into the workflow input, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_intake_runtime.py -k intake_carries_the_configured_cost_cap`
- [ ] Intake falls back to the shared default caps when no setting overrides them, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_intake_runtime.py -k intake_falls_back_to_the_default_caps`
- [ ] The demo entry point carries all three configured caps into the workflow input, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_demo_draft_pr_budget.py -k demo_run_carries_the_configured_caps`

## Testing
Run each acceptance criterion selector on its own. Run `PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/inv ci` before closing the ticket.
